title: Membership Fee Charging Rules — Northgate Memberships Ledger Standard
content:
**Standard 1 — one entry per fee.** Every fee of Northgate Memberships is charged as its own entry on the membership ledger, carrying its fee type (new membership fee, renewal fee, upgrade difference fee or add-on card fee) and the membership year it pays for.

**Standard 2 — add-on card fee.** An add-on card fee equals the tier's business add-on card fee for each add-on card, for the membership year in which the card is issued. Where the tier does not reduce the add-on fee for a card issued mid-year, it is charged in full whatever the issue date. It is charged again for every active add-on card at each renewal.

**Standard 3 — paying a renewal with an Annual Reward certificate.** A renewal paid with an Annual Reward certificate is allowed only where the tier allows a certificate to pay a renewal fee. The certificate is applied in full as a renewal fee entry with the tender "reward certificate"; when its value is smaller than the fee, the remainder is charged as a second renewal fee entry on the member's other tender. A certificate worth more than the renewal fee is not applied to a renewal and is redeemed at a club register instead.

**Standard 4 — sales tax.** Sales tax on membership fees is not charged by Northgate.

**Standard 5 — duplicates.** A charge repeated for the same fee type, membership year and add-on card is a duplicate and is refunded with the refund reason "duplicate charge".

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

The following clauses of this standard are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis and no longer applies as written:

- "A new membership fee or renewal fee equals the annual fee of the tier the membership year is held at." — no longer in force.
- "An upgrade difference fee equals the annual fee of the upgrade target tier less the annual fee of the current tier; it is never prorated and pays only for the rest of the current membership year." — no longer in force.

## Certificate as renewal tender — cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Certificate value against the renewal fee | Treatment |
|---|---|
| tier does not allow a certificate for renewals | certificate not used for the renewal |
| smaller than the fee (e.g. a 20.00 certificate against a 50.00 fee) | 20.00 entry paid by the certificate, plus a second renewal entry of 30.00 on the member's other tender |
| equal to the fee | one renewal entry paid in full by the certificate |
| larger than the fee | not applied to the renewal; redeemed at a club register |

## Duplicate test (hypothetical)

Two add-on card fee entries for the same add-on card and the same membership year: the second is a duplicate and is refunded as a duplicate charge. Two add-on card fee entries for two different add-on cards in the same year are not duplicates.

superseded_clauses: A new_term or renewal_term fee equals the annual_fee_usd of the tier the membership year is held at.

An upgrade_difference fee equals the annual_fee_usd of the upgrade_target_tier minus the annual_fee_usd of the current tier; it is never prorated and pays only for the rest of the current membership year.
